hero.heading: Privacy, terms & responsible use
hero.subheading: How SAATHI is intended to be used, how information is handled, and the limits of AI-assisted responses.

disclaimer.heading: AI Disclaimer
disclaimer.subheading: Read this before relying on anything SAATHI tells you.
disclaimer.banner: SAATHI is an informational assistance tool, not a substitute for official BIS documentation or professional regulatory advice.

points.title: AI-assisted, not infallible
points.desc: SAATHI uses retrieval-augmented generation to explain standards from indexed clauses. Language models can occasionally misread nuance or summarize incompletely.

points.title: Non-authoritative outputs
points.desc: Nothing SAATHI generates is an official statutory ruling, certification grant, or binding legal determination.

points.title: Mandatory source verification
points.desc: Always confirm cited standard numbers and clause references against the official document before making a compliance or manufacturing decision.

points.title: Sample data in some areas
points.desc: Parts of the catalogue, classification wizard, and analysis results use sample data to illustrate the intended workflow.

points.title: Roadmap vs. active features
points.desc: Some workflows and panels represent planned capabilities rather than features that are live today.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how information is handled within SAATHI, built for SIH26107. SAATHI favors transparent and cautious data handling over collecting more than it needs.

collection.title: Information We May Collect
collection.content: Depending on which features are enabled, SAATHI may process:
items: Information you choose to share during a conversation.
Role selections where applicable (citizen, MSME, professional, auditor).
The questions and search queries you submit.
Documents you upload for analysis or clause matching.
Basic technical telemetry needed to operate and secure the service.
collection.note: SAATHI does not sell personal data or use it for marketing. Sessions run locally or against secure endpoints without persistent user tracking.

usage.title: How Information May Be Used
usage.content: Any information processed is used only for these purposes:
items: Answering your question and surfacing relevant standards.
Responding accurately to search and navigation requests.
Improving retrieval relevance and answer accuracy over time.
Maintaining the security and stability of the service.

documents.title: Documents & Queries
documents.content: When using document analysis or classification features, avoid submitting confidential, proprietary, or personally sensitive material unless the deployed service explicitly provides enterprise-grade protections for it.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: Retention depends on the deployed environment and hosting infrastructure. Query logs and transient data may be cleared periodically or kept only long enough for debugging and evaluation.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: Reasonable technical and organizational safeguards protect SAATHI's communications and endpoints. No digital service, AI-backed or otherwise, can guarantee absolute security.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Depending on configuration, the deployed system may rely on third-party cloud infrastructure, vector databases, or AI providers for natural-language processing. Requests may pass through these underlying services.

rights.title: User Rights
rights.content: You may have rights to access, correct, or delete your information, depending on applicable regional data-protection regulations and the deployment's own policies.

contact.title: Contact & Inquiries
contact.content: For questions about these privacy practices, reach the project team via

terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using SAATHI, you agree to the terms below, which define acceptable use and the scope of this assistive tool.

purpose.title: Purpose of SAATHI
purpose.content: SAATHI is an assistive navigation tool that helps citizens, MSMEs, manufacturers, and professionals discover and understand Indian Standards (IS) and Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) services.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.content: You agree to use SAATHI responsibly and lawfully. Specifically, you must:
items: Use the platform only for lawful, educational, and exploratory purposes.
Avoid automated scraping or abusive interactions that degrade availability.
Not attempt to disrupt, reverse-engineer, or compromise SAATHI's infrastructure.
Avoid submitting unlawful, defamatory, or malicious content through the query interface.
Independently verify any critical regulatory or conformity requirement.

accuracy.title: Accuracy & Availability
accuracy.content: While SAATHI aims for accurate, citation-backed guidance:
items: Information may be incomplete, summarized, or open to interpretation.
AI-assisted responses can occasionally contain errors or omissions.
Standards and Quality Control Orders (QCOs) change over time.
The service is offered on an "as-is" and "as-available" basis.

officialSources.title: Official Sources & Verification
officialSources.content: SAATHI is an informational guide, not a statutory authority. Consult official BIS publications, gazettes, and portals for binding regulatory decisions.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.content: Indian Standards (IS specifications), official trademarks, and certification marks (such as ISI and Hallmark) belong to the Bureau of Indian Standards or their respective owners. SAATHI claims no ownership of official standards or regulatory materials.

limitation.title: Limitation of Responsibility
limitation.content: SAATHI is provided without warranty of any kind. Neither SAATHI nor its contributors are liable for business decisions, filings, certification outcomes, or legal liabilities arising from reliance on its outputs. SAATHI does not provide legal, engineering, or certification advice.

changesService.title: Changes to the Service
changesService.content: Features, datasets, and interface components may be modified, added, or removed at any time as the project evolves.

changesTerms.title: Changes to These Terms
changesTerms.content: These terms may be updated periodically to reflect product changes, regulatory updates, or deployment context.

authority.title: Official Authority & Reference Notice
authority.content: For authoritative information, refer to official Bureau of Indian Standards publications, standards, notifications, and applicable regulatory documents at
authority.context: SAATHI was created for Smart India Hackathon 2026 under problem statement SIH26107. It is not an officially authorized BIS service.
